study_material.title: Blood Relations - Complete Study Notes
study_material.introduction: Blood relation puzzles describe a chain of family links and ask how two people are related. Draw a quick family tree with generations stacked vertically, and the answer reads off the diagram.
learning_objectives: Decode chained relation statements ('my father's only son')
Draw family trees with clear generation levels

concepts.heading: 1. Core Vocabulary
concepts.body: Father's/mother's son = brother; father's/mother's daughter = sister. Father's brother = uncle, father's sister = aunt. Brother's/sister's son = nephew, daughter = niece. Grandfather's only son = father. Spouse's relatives take 'in-law'.

concepts.heading: 2. The Tree Method
concepts.body: Put older generations above, same generation side by side, marriages as horizontal links. Use squares/plus for male, circles/minus for female. Work through the statement clause by clause from the END: 'the daughter of my grandfather's only son' - first resolve 'grandfather's only son' (= father), then 'father's daughter' (= sister).

concepts.heading: 3. Photograph Puzzles
concepts.body: 'Pointing to a photo, X says: ...' Resolve the description to find the person in the photo relative to X. Watch for the speaker's gender - some answers (like 'son' vs 'daughter' claims) depend on it, and if the gender is unknown the answer may be 'cannot be determined'.

concepts.heading: 4. Coded Relations
concepts.body: Some questions use symbols: 'A + B means A is the father of B', etc. Translate each symbol into tree edges and rebuild the chain. Answer strictly from the final tree, not intuition.

formulas: Father's only son = the speaker's brother, or the speaker himself if male and an only son - context decides
Only son/only daughter phrases pin down identity
Uncle/aunt = parent's sibling; nephew/niece = sibling's child
shortcut_methods: Resolve nested phrases from the innermost outward
Draw the tree - 20 seconds of sketching prevents most errors
Flag gender-ambiguous speakers before finalising the answer
common_mistakes: Forgetting 'my father's only son' is the speaker himself (when male)
Skipping the tree for 'easy' questions and mislinking generations
study_material.summary: Parse from the innermost phrase, sketch generations vertically, and check gender assumptions before answering.

solved_examples.question: Pointing to a boy, Amit (an only child) says: 'He is the son of my father's only son.' Who is the boy to Amit?
solved_examples.step_by_step: Father's only son = Amit himself. The boy is Amit's son.

solved_examples.question: Pointing to a photo, Sita says: 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' Who is she to Sita?
solved_examples.step_by_step: Grandfather's only son = Sita's father. His daughter = Sita's sister.

solved_examples.question: A is B's brother. B is C's sister. C is D's father. How is A related to D?
solved_examples.step_by_step: A, B, C are siblings; C's child D makes A the uncle.

solved_examples.question: Introducing a man, a woman said: 'His wife is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
solved_examples.step_by_step: Only daughter of her mother = the woman herself. The man's wife is her - he is her husband.

practice_questions.question: P is the mother of Q; Q is the brother of R. How is P related to R?
practice_questions.explanation: Q and R are siblings, so P mothers both.

practice_questions.question: Pointing to a man, Ravi says: 'He is the brother of my mother.' The man is Ravi's:
A is the father of B. C is the daughter of B. D is the brother of B. How is C related to D?
Pointing to a photo, Mohan says: 'She is the mother of my son's sister.' Who is she to Mohan?
practice_questions.explanation: My son's sister = my daughter; her mother = my wife.

practice_questions.question: X is the grandfather of Y through Y's father, and Z is also a grandparent of Y through the same son. If X and Z are not the same person, how are X and Z related?
practice_questions.explanation: Grandfather and grandmother of Y on the same (father's) side are spouses.

topic_test.title: Blood Relations - Topic Test
instructions: +1 for correct, -0.25 for wrong, 0 for unattempted.
Sketch a family tree for every chained question.

questions.question: A is B's father. B is C's mother. A is C's:
questions.explanation: Two generations up on the mother's side.

questions.question: Pointing to a woman, Karan says: 'She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather.' The woman is Karan's:
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son = Karan's father; his daughter = Karan's sister.

questions.question: M is the brother of N. N is the sister of P. P is the father of Q. How is M related to Q?
questions.explanation: M is a sibling of Q's father.

questions.question: In 'A + B means A is the mother of B; A - B means A is the brother of B', what does P + Q - R mean for P and R?
options: P is the mother of R
P is the aunt of R
P is the sister of R
P is the grandmother of R
questions.correct_answer: P is the mother of R
questions.explanation: P is mother of Q; Q is brother of R, so P mothers both Q and R.

questions.question: Introducing a boy, a man says: 'He is the son of my wife's mother's only daughter.' The boy is the man's:
questions.explanation: Wife's mother's only daughter = the wife. Her son = his son.

questions.question: Deepak said: 'This girl is the wife of the grandson of my mother.' How is Deepak related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Grandson of Deepak's mother = Deepak's son. The girl is his son's wife.
